study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective observational cohort study
cohort: 9450 nulliparous women enrolled in the Nulliparous Pregnancy Outcomes Study Monitoring-to-be (nuMom2b) study
finding: While placental abruption was identified in less than 1% of nulliparous women, it was significantly associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery and blood transfusion.
mod_finding: Placental abruption was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery, even after adjusting for confounders.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery: 35.6 ± 4.4 weeks for women with abruption, 38.8 ± 2.2 weeks for women without abruption
